query_plan.interpretation: Display lead sponsor connected to drug interventions in trials for Fabry disease.

warnings: Visualization displays only 75 of 81 edges; complete registry retrieval does not mean complete visualization coverage
183 post-filter studies did not contribute to the displayed visualization (missing chart fields or display limits)
assumptions: Edges are weighted by distinct NCT IDs; duplicates within the same study do not inflate weight.
Only the top 75 edges by study count are returned; other relationships are omitted.
Sponsor nodes represent the lead sponsor only; drug nodes use registered intervention names.
